title: Treatment of a leg ulcer
what: This is a wound on the lower leg that does not heal for a long time, most often because the veins are not working well. Treatment is dressings and leg compression.
why: For wounds on the lower leg that have not healed for several weeks.
duration: a dressing change usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; treatment takes weeks and months
tell_doctor: Artery disease, leg pain when walking

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: An ultrasound of the leg veins and arteries is usually done to find the cause.

prepare.title: Compression
prepare.text: Bandages or stockings are the main treatment. Wear them as your doctor prescribed.

prepare.title: Legs
prepare.text: When you sit or lie down, raise your leg higher.

bring: Your referral and the vein ultrasound
Compression stockings, if you have them
steps: The wound and the skin around it are washed
The doctor examines the wound and sometimes cleans it
A dressing is put on the wound
The leg is wrapped over it with a compression bandage
You are told when the next dressing change is
feel: Cleaning the wound can be unpleasant
Compression feels strange in the first days, then usually gets easier
If the bandage is very tight and your leg goes numb, take it off and call your doctor
after: Raise your leg when you rest
After the ulcer heals, keep wearing stockings - this makes the ulcer less likely to come back
red_flags: Your leg is numb, cold or blue under the bandage
Severe pain or a bad smell from the wound

faq.a: Compression helps blood flow back up the veins. Without it the ulcer heals very slowly.
Sometimes, for example by treating the veins. Your doctor will discuss it after the ultrasound.

reminders.text: Leg dressing change tomorrow. Take the vein ultrasound and your compression stockings.
